description: This file defines a static extension class for configuring placement filters in Orleans, using dependency injection. It provides a method to add a placement filter and its director to the service collection.

classes.name: PlacementFilterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring placement filters in Orleans.

methods.name: AddPlacementFilter
methods.description: Configures and adds a placement filter and its director to the service collection with specified lifetime.
